constraints.name: listing_fact_evidence_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK ((((kind = 'exact'::text) AND (exact_value IS NOT NULL) AND (category_term_id IS NULL) AND (range_lower IS NULL) AND (range_upper IS NULL) AND (lower_inclusive IS NULL) AND (upper_inclusive IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'category'::text) AND (exact_value IS NULL) AND (category_term_id IS NOT NULL) AND (range_lower IS NULL) AND (range_upper IS NULL) AND (lower_inclusive IS NULL) AND (upper_inclusive IS NULL) AND (dimension <> 'distance_to_paved_road'::text)) OR ((kind = 'range'::text) AND (exact_value IS NULL) AND (category_term_id IS NULL) AND ((range_lower IS NOT NULL) OR (range_upper IS NOT NULL)) AND (lower_inclusive IS NOT NULL) AND (upper_inclusive IS NOT NULL) AND ((range_lower IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT lower_inclusive)) AND ((range_upper IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT upper_inclusive)) AND (NOT isempty(numrange(range_lower, range_upper, (
CASE
    WHEN lower_inclusive THEN '['::text
    ELSE '('::text
END ||
CASE
    WHEN upper_inclusive THEN ']'::text
    ELSE ')'::text
END)))))))

constraints.name: listing_fact_evidence_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((exact_value IS NULL) OR (exact_value >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((range_lower IS NULL) OR (range_lower >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((range_upper IS NULL) OR (range_upper >= (0)::numeric))))

constraints.name: listing_fact_evidence_check4
constraints.definition: CHECK (((dimension <> ALL (ARRAY['bedrooms'::text, 'parking'::text, 'year_built'::text])) OR (((exact_value IS NULL) OR (exact_value = trunc(exact_value))) AND ((range_lower IS NULL) OR (range_lower = trunc(range_lower))) AND ((range_upper IS NULL) OR (range_upper = trunc(range_upper))))))

constraints.name: listing_fact_evidence_check5
constraints.definition: CHECK (((dimension <> 'year_built'::text) OR (((exact_value IS NULL) OR ((exact_value >= (1)::numeric) AND (exact_value <= (9999)::numeric))) AND ((range_lower IS NULL) OR ((range_lower >= (1)::numeric) AND (range_lower <= (9999)::numeric))) AND ((range_upper IS NULL) OR ((range_upper >= (1)::numeric) AND (range_upper <= (9999)::numeric))))))

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES listings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((event_type = 'create'::text) AND (previous_state IS NULL) AND (resulting_state = 'draft'::text)) OR ((previous_state IS NOT NULL) AND (((event_type = 'publish'::text) AND (previous_state = 'draft'::text) AND (resulting_state = 'active'::text)) OR ((event_type = 'renew'::text) AND (previous_state = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'expired'::text])) AND (resulting_state = 'active'::text)) OR ((event_type = 'unpublish'::text) AND (previous_state = 'active'::text) AND (resulting_state = 'draft'::text)) OR ((event_type = 'expire'::text) AND (previous_state = 'active'::text) AND (resulting_state = 'expired'::text)) OR ((event_type = 'archive'::text) AND (previous_state = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'active'::text, 'expired'::text])) AND (resulting_state = 'archived'::text)) OR ((event_type = 'restore'::text) AND (previous_state = ANY (ARRAY['archived'::text, 'deleted'::text])) AND (resulting_state = 'draft'::text)) OR ((event_type = 'delete'::text) AND (previous_state = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'active'::text, 'expired'::text, 'archived'::text])) AND (resulting_state = 'deleted'::text))))))
